recent.text: Half: Heat 64, Jazz 54 - Antetokounmpo 15pts/4reb/2ast - Larsson 10pts/2reb/2ast - Mitchell 8pts/4reb/5ast - Thompson 7pts - Wiggins 7pts Wasn't a pretty half, but the Heat have a double-digit lead at halftime. Need to put together a good second half and end the trip with a win.

recent.quoted_text: Giannis Antetokounmpo just got whistled for his third personal foul on an illegal screen. Erik Spoelstra is going to challenge the call. Looked like Josh Okogie did a nice job selling the contact, but those illegal screens were a preseason point of emphasis for officials.
